en: Oh right, I should go see Xiaomei first.
I've got plenty of fine weapons here.
I've got plenty of fine goods here.
Granny Cai has been acting strange lately. She keeps herself shut up in her room.
Dongdong: Sigh, the demons have gotten so bad lately. Everyone's on edge...
Dongdong: Now that the monster's dead, things are much more relaxed. We can even go out for a stroll at night again.
Old Meng: My boyfriend Ah Jun hasn't come back to see me in ages. I miss him so much. Could you take a letter to him for me?
I wonder when he'll come back.
Everyone calls me "Madman", but I'm actually very handsome!
Ah Xia: Being a clerk in the development department is a lot more work than you'd think.

Ah Xia: Nobody's seen Granny Cai's daughter, Little Painter, for days. Li Hu, the bully of Stonedream, snatches girls in broad daylight, and Granny Cai went to the market there a few days ago... I hope it's not that. How awful...
Oh, my daughter... Now I'm just a lonely old woman with no one left. I might as well die and be done with it!
Granny, please don't talk like that. I'll rescue your daughter.
That Li Hu is the town bully, with over a hundred thugs. Don't go throwing your life away.
Don't worry, Granny, my kung fu is really good. I'm not bragging - forget a hundred, I could knock down a thousand in the blink of an eye.
Really?! If you can bring my girl back, I'll give anything! I'm counting on you, Master Taoist.
Oh my, benefactor, you've come! My daughter is back home. She's staying at her uncle's for now.
I have a family heirloom. Please accept it, benefactor - don't turn it down.
Come and visit whenever you have time.
Hello, I'm Liu Qingfeng, a disciple of Wuji of Sanqing Hall. Are you the Elder of Heartsease?
I am. This old man is Murong Xuan. What can I do for you, Master Taoist?
My master said there are demons here. He sent me.
So you've come to rid us of the monster! At last, a savior!
So there really is a demon. Master sure lives up to his reputation.
The monster is half man, half snake. Two days ago it came to our village demanding young boys, and said it would wipe us all out if we refused. Four people have been killed already.
Do you know where the monster is now?
Only that it comes and goes from the Miasma Wood south of the village.
Rest easy, Elder. I'll go get rid of it right now.
I have a daughter who has studied medicine since she was little. She can lend you a hand.
I'd like to go with you and fight the demon, Master Taoist.
Then let's set off right away.
Master Taoist, Xiaomei, please be careful!
Brother Liu, you came to see me! I'm so glad.
I'm on my way to Mt. Zhong to help my uncle deal with some demons. I was passing by, so I thought I'd drop in.
Demons... I want to come too.
It's not like last time. Even my uncle is calling for help. It's dangerous.
I'm not afraid. I'm all alone now, with nothing to hold me back. I'm sure my dad would agree if he were here!
How did we end up here?
Murong Xiaomei: This is the Heartsease Graveyard. It's very close to the village.
Oh no! If the old snake came out this way, it must have gone to the village. Let's hurry back!
Snake Demon: You dare bring in help against me? I'll kill every last one of you...
Xiaomei, don't grieve too much. I'm so sorry...
Mm. I'll take care of myself.
I have to go back and report to my master. You don't need to see me off any further.
Take care, and come back to see us often.
Let's head up the mountain first.
The miasma here is so thick there's no way to get in!
My family has hunted here for generations. I know this area like the back of my hand.
Excuse me, hunter, how can I get into the Miasma Wood here?
The miasma in that wood is deadly. Unless you wear the "Reed Mail", you'll be dead within moments of going in.
What kind of treasure is this "Reed Mail"?
They say it's armor made by Lord Lu that protects against poison. It was handed down to his descendant, Lu Fu, who lives in Stonedream, not far from here.
Snake Demon: I told you to bring the boys to the edge of the Miasma Wood after dark. What are you doing here now?
Look closely, old snake. This Taoist is here to sort you out!
Snake Demon: You're tough, I'll give you that. I'll seal you in this cave for good!
Snake Demon: My, what big talk. I was getting a bit peckish - you'll make a nice snack.
Snake Demon: Looks like this snack won't go down so easily.
Xiaomei, tonight Brother Liu is treating you to snake soup.
Snake Demon: This brat's getting cockier by the minute.
This is no place to play around. Get lost!
Anyone who dares make trouble here gets his legs broken!
These two dogs sure are fierce @#%@#!@#
Hmph, dealing with you two was a piece of cake.
Guard 1: Kid, you want to die? Happy to oblige.
Guard 2: And the girl goes to the Boss.
Don't be scared, Xiaomei. These two are nothing.
Mm. Don't waste words on them. Let's beat these dogs.
It's nice to come into town for some fun now and then.
I wonder where I can buy flowers.
Plenty of rain this year. Should be a good harvest.
There's a big mansion in this town. It belongs to Li Hu.
Show mercy where you can, and good things will come back to you.
Without simplicity, one cannot show one's will; without calm, one cannot reach far.
Old Wang: Ah, hero, you've come! Welcome!
Old Wang: This is my wife. She used to be a wet nurse at Li Manor, so she knows the place well.
Mrs. Wang: Thank you for sparing my husband.
Show mercy where you can. Besides, Old Wang isn't really a bad guy.
Mrs. Wang: Back when I was a wet nurse at Li Manor, I often heard the other servants whisper about a secret passage there.
Old Wang: It's true, I've heard it too.
Old Wang: Drop by anytime, hero.
Mrs. Wang: I wonder if Old Wang will be home for dinner.
I've got plenty of fine medicine here.
I've got plenty of fine goods here.
You won't find fairer prices anywhere.
I've got plenty of fine weapons here.
Excuse me, is this the home of Lord Lu's descendant?
It is. I am Lu Fu. What brings you here, Master Taoist?
I need to go into the Miasma Wood south of Heartsease to slay a demon. I was hoping to borrow the Reed Mail.
Ah, you're a little too late, Master Taoist. Yesterday Li Hu, the town bully, came with a gang and took it.
I'll get it back for you right away. But afterwards, you have to lend it to me first.
Of course. Thank you in advance.
Him again! I'll get it back for you right away. But afterwards, you have to lend it to me first.
Of course. Thank you in advance.
Mr. Lu, I've got your treasure back.
You fight demons and uphold the Way. I'd like you to keep the treasure.
I'm a descendant of Lord Lu, but sadly the family has fallen on hard times...
Those who do evil bring ruin on themselves.
Reckless whelp! You dare poke the tiger?
Li Hu, you've done nothing but evil. Today I'll deliver justice in Heaven's name!
Don't be afraid. I'm here to save you.
Girl: Thank you both for saving my life!
You must be Granny Cai's daughter, Little Painter?
Granny Cai is waiting for you at home. Hurry back.
Fighting for justice sure feels good.
Old Wang: I'm just an ordinary servant. Please don't kill me!
Don't listen to his lies. He led the way every time they did something rotten.
You won't change your ways. You deserve to die!
Thank you, hero! I live here in Stonedream. Come find me if you ever need anything.
Old Wang: So you think the tiger's a sick cat just because it hasn't roared? I'm not scared of you. Bring it on!
I think we'd better hurry to Mt. Heming.
Hurry up the mountain and help!
A whirlpool! We can use it to get down into the sea.
The seawater here is so dense even a stone would barely sink, let alone a person.
Lots of people here. We could ask around whether anyone's seen Sister Yuan.
Right. Let's ask at that inn we stayed at last time.
I don't think this is the way to Whitewater.
I don't think this is the way to Mt. Zhong.
Whoa! Who left a money pouch lying in here?!
Passerby: Hey, that's my money pouch! Hand it over!
Passerby: Kid, you're asking for a beating! Boys, get him!!!
Finders keepers, losers weepers - the law's on my side!
Passerby: Tough guy, huh? We're out of here.
Passerby: Smart kid, you know what's good for you. Come on, boys, drinks are on me.
Why do I get the feeling I just got conned...
Passerby: You again? Following us? Want a beating?
Passerby: Tough guy, huh? We're out of here.
Sorry, sir, upstairs is under construction. It's not open yet.
I'm just having a look around.
Innkeeper: What can I do for you, sir?
Innkeeper, have you seen the young lady who was with us last time?
Oh, yes. She had lunch here just yesterday. When she left, I think she headed toward Whitewater.
Innkeeper: Will you be staying the night, sir, or having a meal?
Neither, thanks. We have to keep moving.
I've got plenty of top-quality weapons.
I've got plenty of top-quality goods.
You won't find fairer prices anywhere.
I've got plenty of top-quality medicines.
Ah Jun: Around town they call me Lockmaster - there's no lock I can't open. I wonder when Old Meng's letter will arrive!
So you must be Ah Jun, Old Meng's boyfriend?
Ah Jun: That's right. You know her?
When I was in Heartsease, she asked me to bring you this letter.
Handed the Love Letter to Ah Jun.
Ah Jun: Thanks for bringing it all this way. Here are three keys I made after years of study. Call it a small thank-you.
Ah Jun: I haven't been home in ages. I should go back and visit.
Thief: Out of the way! Out of the way!
Catching thieves is my specialty. Leave this to me.
Weird, how did the thief turn into a girl...
Sister, you clearly have real skill. So why would you...
My name is Yuan Pingzhi. I'd rather not talk about my past.
Skills like that, and wasted on this. What a shame.
Sister Yuan, demons run wild these days. With skills like yours, why not help rid the people of them?
When I woke up this morning, Sister Yuan wasn't here. She must have left.
Oh well, everyone has their own path. Let's head for Mt. Zhong.
There's still something important to take care of here!
Taoist Chongxu: Qingfeng, the demons have retreated... Why have you come out?
Uncle, it's all because my skills weren't good enough. The Tyrant Bell has been stolen.
Taoist Chongxu: It is the will of Heaven... Are you hurt? ...Where is Miss Yuan?
We're fine. Xiaomei and I were knocked out, and when we came to, she was gone.
Taoist Chongxu: The fate of all living things depends on this. The Tyrant Bell must be recovered.
I'll go and bring the Tyrant Bell back.
Taoist Chongxu: Good. Leave the mountain at once and find Miss Yuan first. I suspect she has a great deal to do with this.
Taoist Chongxu: I must stay to run things on the mountain. Find the Tyrant Bell as fast as you can, before the land is drowned in suffering.
We have plenty of fine medicines to choose from.
I've been waiting here for you a long time. I've thought it over - I'm joining you.
Something's not right... Oh no, Uncle's in danger!
Thunderling: You pack of demons dare run riot here? Today Lord Thunder is going to round up the lot of you!
Zhong Taoist: Thank goodness you got here in time, Brother Liu, or we'd have been done for.
Take me to my uncle, quickly.
Zhong Taoist: Yes. Master is waiting for you on the back mountain.
Taoist Chongxu: Qingfeng, you came just in time. You've broken the demons' siege of Mt. Zhong.
No need to thank me, Uncle. Slaying demons and defending the Way is my duty.
Taoist Chongxu: Well done. I believe this great demon assault on Mt. Zhong is aimed at the Tyrant Bell. Its power is immense - if it fell into demon hands, the consequences would be unthinkable.
I'll do everything I can to protect the Tyrant Bell.
Taoist Chongxu: Good. One more thing. Miss Yuan, behind you, carries a strong demonic aura - yet there's righteousness in her too. Keep an eye on her.
Taoist Chongxu: Go and get some rest for now.
Zhong Taoist: Master asks you to come to the back mountain.

Taoist Chongxu: Qingfeng, I've divined that the demons will launch an all-out attack on Mt. Zhong today, and I fear my disciples can't hold them. You should be able to guard the Bell in the cave. I'll go meet the enemy.
Yes. I'll go into the cave right away.
I wonder how the battle outside is going.
Crimson: Not bad, you lot. But you'll never withstand my ultimate move!
Liu Qingfeng and Murong Xiaomei pass out.
That old demon is really something.
She wasn't here when I woke up.
Could Uncle have been right about her? Let's go find him.
Crimson: Hahahaha, the Tyrant Bell is mine! Haha...
Mayor: You're all back! You're not hurt, are you?
Mayor: Good, good. What happened in there?
We've wiped out the demons inside. The old demon left the missing children in the dry well at the old manor. Go and bring them out. They're in a deathlike sleep, but they'll wake up in seven days.
Mayor: You two, go rescue them.
Mayor: You are our town's great benefactors. We've nothing fine to offer, but please come to my humble home for a cup of tea.
Let's head north after the Tyrant Bell.
Watchman: You can't go in here.
We'd like to go in and take a look.
Watchman: There are ghosts in there. The Mayor told us to stand guard so nobody goes in and gets hurt.
Watchman: We follow the Mayor's orders.
Passerby: Oh, son, look how big you've grown! And that must be my daughter-in-law next to you.
Passerby: You're not my son. Who are you? Who are you?
Passerby: My boy, my boy... boy...
Passerby: Why did you take my son away? You...
Passerby: When Heaven is about to give my son a great mission, it will surely first...
Let's have a look around first, shall we?
There's something odd about this well.
The sound seems to be coming from inside the well.
Great martial arts won't always save you, but a good weapon will always give you the edge.
Sigh... So many children missing. Where on earth do we even look...
Excuse me, are you the Mayor?
Mayor: I am. I'm the Mayor of Whitewater.
I hear children go missing here every day. I suspect it has something to do with the old manor to the south. We'd like to go in and investigate.
Mayor: No, no, no. I appreciate the kind offer, but that old manor is far too dangerous.
We're not afraid. We know how to deal with demons.
Mayor: No, no, no. That old manor really is too dangerous.
Mayor: Whoever goes in rarely comes out. A Taoist once went in to subdue the demon and never came back. Yesterday a young lady insisted on going in, and she still hasn't come out.
Mayor: I won't let the same mistake happen again. I can't allow you to go in.
Mayor: Sigh, when I think of that girl, I still feel guilty. A stranger in town, all alone...
Mayor, the young lady you mentioned is our friend. We came all the way from Mt. Zhong to find her. Slaying demons and defending the Way @!$#@!$, not to mention #$%!#@!@#
Mayor: Very well, I'll let you in. But promise me that at the first sign of danger, you'll run straight back.
Mayor: Do drop by again when you have time.
Innkeeper: Will you be having a meal, sir, or staying the night?
We've seen a lot of people wandering the streets like they've lost their minds. What's going on? Could you tell us, Innkeeper?
Innkeeper: You must be from out of town, sir. A lot of strange things have been happening here lately.
Innkeeper: Every night, some family in town has a child vanish without a trace. Those crazed folk in the streets lost their children, couldn't find them anywhere, and went mad with grief.
Innkeeper: And lately, every night, you can hear a woman crying in an old manor to the south. It's terrifying.
Innkeeper: Will you be having a meal, sir, or staying the night?
This is an old, established shop. Everyone around here knows us.
My shop may be small, but I've still got some good stuff.
You won't find fairer prices anywhere.
I think I hear something outside.
The crying seems to be getting louder.
It's so gloomy in here. It gives me the creeps.
The killing aura here is overwhelming. Some powerful demon must have set up an array here to train.
There's someone over there. I think it's Sister Yuan.
Careful! This is a Soulsnare Array. It drains the souls and spirit energy of anyone who enters, to power the evil art of Soulsnare. It's one of the Seven Evil Arrays.
Is there any way to break it?

To break it, dig up the pregnant women's bodies buried head-down at the eight trigram points around the array, and lay them right side up. But they were all buried alive upside down, so their yin energy is extremely strong. They can turn into any kind of monster.
Right where those eight stones are. Be careful.
We shouldn't stick around here. Let's get out, fast.
Crimson: You again! I failed to kill you last time, and now you've wrecked my Soulsnare Array. Nothing but your deaths will soothe my rage this time!
Hmph! You stole the Tyrant Bell that day and left me to take the blame. I won't spare you either!
Crimson: Well, kid, you've actually gotten better.
Scared, huh? Hand over the Tyrant Bell, or you won't even get to stay a demon.
Crimson: Big talk. I've already given the Tyrant Bell to its rightful owner. Too bad you'll never get to meet him. Hahaha... Have at you!
I can't move right now. It's all up to you!
Miss Yuan, what are you doing here?

After the battle with Crimson on Mt. Zhong, I saw that his Soulsnare had you both dazed, so I went down the mountain alone to track him. In Whitewater I heard about the missing children and traced it here, but I stumbled into the Soulsnare Array and got stuck.
No. If it weren't for you two, I might not even be alive. Oh right, what brings you here?
We were tracking things down too.
This place is too dangerous. Let's get out first and talk later.
Murong Xiaomei and Yuan Pingzhi join the party.
Mayor: Won't you honored benefactors stay a little longer?
No, we have urgent business, so we can't stay. Thank you for your warm hospitality.
Mayor: It was the least I could do. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Mayor, have you seen anyone pass through here with a big bell in the last couple of days?
Mayor: Actually, yes. The day before yesterday, a band of strange-looking folk came through town dragging a huge bell.
Do you know who they were?
Mayor: No idea. All I know is they headed north.
Thank you. We'll be on our way.
Mayor: Let me see you out.
Mayor: Then do drop by again when you have time.
Murong Xiaomei and Yuan Pingzhi join the party.
